name: Trend Reality Check
description: Test whether a required topic shows sustained Google search interest, a short-lived spike, or weak evidence by combining topic-specific Google Trends views with the seedless Trending Now feed, recent Google News Light coverage, Search Index source discovery, and a Canvas assessment. Trending Now is used only as a cross-check and is never treated as a topic filter.

steps.abort_speech: Trend Reality Check requires a topic after the command, for example /trend_reality_check agentic AI.
steps.description: Measure three months of topic-specific Google search interest
Find rising and top related searches
Cross-check the seedless current US Trending Now feed
Check for recent news catalysts and event-driven spikes
Discover indexed source pages for broader context
Create the dated Canvas trend assessment

success_speech: The trend reality check for ${topic_name} is ready in Canvas.
partial_speech: The trend reality check for ${topic_name} is ready in Canvas using the trend and context sources that were available.
abort_speech: Trend Reality Check could not be completed. Include a topic after the command.
